title: RepurposeReady
description: The shorter pieces were written and are handed over in full, for the same reason a generation is. Keys are snake_case, not the camelCase the rest of leaf uses: this travels inside a Liquid envelope, whose own fields (event_id, occurred_at, event_type, owner_unit_ref) are snake_case and pinned byte-exact by signed golden vectors. The shape follows the wire.

job_id.description: The job the work was done under, which is what the asker was waiting on.

session_id.description: The working session it was done in.

formats.description: What came out, keyed by the format that was asked for — hooks, captions, and the rest. A format that was asked for and produced nothing is simply not here.
